words.def: A bird has feathers and wings. Most birds can fly and sing.
words.sentence: We saw a colourful bird in the tree.
words.adultDef: An animal with feathers, wings and a beak. Most birds can fly.

words.def: A girl is a young female person.
ask: Can you name a girl in your class or family?
words.sentence: The girl next door has a new puppy.
words.adultDef: A child who is female. A girl grows up to be a woman.

words.def: First means number one, before all the others, like coming first in a race.
words.sentence: I came first in the race.
words.adultDef: Before all the others – number 1. If you come first in a race, you win!

words.def: A shirt is something you wear on the top half of your body. It often has buttons and a collar.
ask: What colour is your favourite shirt ?
words.sentence: I wore a new shirt to school today.
words.adultDef: Clothes you wear on the top half of your body, like a T-shirt or a school shirt.

words.def: Dirt is soil or mud. You get dirt on your shoes when you play outside.
words.sentence: My shoes were covered in dirt after footy.
words.adultDef: Soil or earth, like in a garden. When dirt gets wet it turns into mud.

words.def: A skirt is clothing that hangs from your waist. It has no legs.
words.sentence: She wore a blue skirt to the party.
words.adultDef: Clothes that hang down from your waist. Some school uniforms have a skirt.
